name: Lyo.Story.Models
tagline: Request and response DTOs and route constants for the Story API.
description: Wire types for story row CRUD, the play-graph aggregate, and playthrough snapshots. `Request/` and `Response/` are separate. Listing uses Lyo.Query on `Story/Stories`, not a story-specific query DTO. Domain POCOs and the play engine stay in `Lyo.Story`.
features: Row Req/Res for stories, scenes, nodes, variables, actions, choices, reactions, effects, and read-only playthroughs.
`StoryGraphReq` / `StoryGraphRes` for the aggregate save and load routes.
`Constants.Rest.Story` route prefixes shared by the API and the client.

examples.title: Route constants
examples.code:
var stories = Constants.Rest.Story.Stories;
var graph = Constants.Rest.Story.Graph;
